title: AUDIT-7 Lane 4 merged-PR audit slice: developing-today/code batch 2/14 (250 PRs)
body:
Lane 4 (MERGED-PR-AUDIT, tracking https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/13879, umbrella https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/13871) continuation slice.

AUDIT each of these merged PRs in developing-today/code (merged since 2026-10-23), ONE BY ONE, IN FULL: read the PR body and its complete diff (fleet gh api repos/developing-today/code/pulls/<n> and /files, per_page=100, count-confirmed), extract the spawning issue (especially Closes/closes/fixes references), read that issue in full, and judge: did the PR fully implement the issue? Check LATER merged PRs in the same repo before filing any gap - if a later PR completed it, record completed-later on both. Where a gap/bug/unfiled next step is real, FILE it in the owning repo (via gh-post), prioritise it, and link it. NEVER use closing keywords in comments on issues that must stay open. Lane 2 owns reopen/correction decisions on closures - post suspect closures as pointers on the umbrella #13871, do not reopen. Apply the Lane 4 outcome labels (defined on code#13879; create them in developing-today/code first if absent): audit:complete / audit:partial / audit:gap-filed / audit:bug-filed / audit:completed-later / audit:no-issue. Post the batch ledger (PR, spawning issue, verdict, filed links) as a comment on code#13879 when the batch is done. Check #13879 and the umbrella for lane claims before acting on any item; a claim from another lane is a hard stop.
